# AI & Engineering Portfolio — Minchul Kim

> A hub of free data-analysis and process-automation tools built with Streamlit and Python by Minchul Kim, Advanced Materials Engineer, plus open-source engineering projects.
> Site: https://workshopcompany.github.io/AI-Projects/

## Tools

- MOLDIQ — Optimization and shrinkage prediction tool for Metal Injection Molding (MIM) processes. https://moldiq.streamlit.app/
- OpenFOAM Injection Automation — Automation tool for OpenFOAM simulations and fluid flow analysis support. https://openfoam-injection-automation.streamlit.app/
- IELTS Speaking Video Maker — AI-powered video generation and learning assistant for IELTS speaking practice. https://ielts-speaking-video-maker.streamlit.app/
- OpenSource Match Program — A matching and management program for open-source project collaboration. https://opensource-match-program.streamlit.app/

## Open-Source Projects

- MetalAtom — Open-source simulation of metal powder gas atomization. https://github.com/workshopcompany/MetalAtom
- Drawing-to-Parametric-CAD — Reads engineering drawings and builds parametric FreeCAD models. https://github.com/workshopcompany/drawing-to-parametric-cad
- likesuno — Local music generation app on open-source YuE2 (Suno-style) — style prompt + lyrics become a finished song with vocals. https://github.com/workshopcompany/likesuno_update
- Reels Maker — Automated Shorts/Reels pipeline for Windows — trend research, script, TTS, scene images, and YouTube upload from a browser UI. https://github.com/workshopcompany/reels_maker_update

## Author

- Minchul Kim, Advanced Materials Engineer. Personal portfolio: https://workshopcompany.github.io/minchul-kim/
